settings.heading: About Our Talented Artists
settings.copy: Explore our diverse range of artists who bring your vision to life. From tattoos to piercings, they cater to all styles and preferences.

settings.heading: A Brief Look at Our Studio's Evolution
settings.copy: Welcome to our story! From our humble beginnings to becoming a celebrated tattoo shop, our journey has been fueled by passion and creativity. Each milestone marks our dedication to perfecting the art of body modification and a commitment to our community. Join us as we reflect on the highlights that shaped who we are today.

settings.heading: Opened Our Doors
settings.copy: We launched our studio with a vision to offer unique and artistic tattoo experiences. This marks the beginning of something beautiful in body art.
settings.alt: Sideshow Productions storefront on State Street in Murray

settings.heading: Expanded Our Services
settings.copy: After receiving an amazing response, we introduced piercings and teeth whitening, providing our clients with even more options for self-expression.
settings.alt: Ear piercings and jewelry from the studio’s original story

settings.heading: Community Focused
settings.copy: We've evolved into a community-focused business, regularly fundraising for nonprofits like the Breast Cancer Research Foundation, Humane Society, Toys for Tots, and more!
settings.alt: Donation collection box filled at the Sideshow studio

settings.heading: Through the Years
settings.copy: Over the years, we’ve grown, evolved, and embraced new trends, all while staying true to our artistic roots. Our story is just beginning!
settings.alt: A studio story image from Sideshow’s original About page

settings.heading: Meet Our Talented Crew
settings.intro: Passionate artists dedicated to transforming your ideas into stunning body art.

settings.name: Sonny
settings.bio: Sonny provides expert piercings with sterile techniques and quality jewelry, ensuring precise placement and thorough aftercare.

settings.name: Megan
settings.bio: Megan specializes in cosmetic tooth gems and teeth whitening, ensuring safe application with quality materials.

settings.name: Jake
settings.bio: Jake combines graphics and shading for clear designs. He’s also skilled in lettering and illustration.

settings.name: Rigo
settings.bio: Rigo works in illustrative styles with clean lines. He clearly explains designs and aftercare in English or Spanish for a straightforward session.

settings.heading: Our Core Values
settings.copy: At our studio, we live by a few guiding principles that shape everything we do. Creativity fuels our passion, ensuring each unique design reflects your personality. We pride ourselves on professionalism, always upholding the highest standards of hygiene and artistry. Most importantly, your satisfaction is our top priority. Your experience matters.

settings.quote: We happen to see that they were doing a fundraiser for the Trevor Project when we drove by. We went in to say Thank You for supporting something that is important to us. Then we ended up getting impromptu tattoos. They are amazing
settings.author: Teinamarrie Scuderi

settings.quote: I got my first professional tattoo here and it looks amazing! Definitely coming back for my next one
settings.author: Lindsay Palmatier
